fusions.name: Hay Toss
fusions.desc: Scoops up everything within 2 tiles ahead on the tines, dealing 10 damage and tossing each target 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Oxgoad
fusions.desc: A long, steady drive with the tines for 28 piercing damage, up to 1.4 times that at its 5-tile limit, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Goaded Herd
fusions.desc: Goads your allies on: every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Slow to Stampede
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack faster for 6 seconds, by 27% at full. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
